brief: The 8 multi-agent patterns every AI builder needs — supervisor, swarm, feedback loop, more.

slots.body: Eight battle-tested patterns that turn scattered LLM calls into reliable, autonomous systems. Build agents that delegate, iterate, and ship.
A central controller delegates tasks to specialist agents, then aggregates results. It reduces complexity by enforcing a single source of truth.
slots.card1Body: Complex workflows requiring coordination across coding, research, or validation roles.
slots.card2Body: The supervisor must own the context window; workers stay stateless and focused.

slots.body: Multiple agents operate in parallel with shared memory, voting or merging outputs. It unlocks speed and diversity in problem solving.
slots.card1Body: High-volume tasks like data extraction, candidate screening, or content variants.
slots.card2Body: Consensus logic beats majority vote; define merge rules before scaling.

slots.body: A generator produces drafts while a critic scores quality, triggering iterative refinement until the output meets a threshold.
slots.card1Body: Quality-critical outputs like code review, copy editing, or synthetic data.
slots.card2Body: Stop conditions prevent infinite loops; cap iterations at three to five.

slots.body: Agents are arranged in a strict sequence where each stage transforms output for the next. It enforces order and auditability.
slots.card1Body: ETL, document processing, or any workflow with clear linear dependencies.
slots.card2Body: Schema contracts between stages prevent type drift and silent failures.

slots.body: An intake agent classifies incoming requests and dispatches them to the most qualified specialist, optimizing latency and accuracy.
slots.card1Body: Multi-domain support bots or platforms with distinct user intents.
slots.card2Body: Fallback to a generalist agent avoids dead-ends on edge-case queries.

slots.body: The agent pauses to evaluate its own output against constraints, then self-corrects before finalizing the response to the user.
slots.card1Body: Constraint-heavy tasks like formatting, policy checks, or safety guardrails.
slots.card2Body: Separate reflection from generation; loading both roles in one call dilutes focus.

slots.body: Start small. Implement one pattern this week and measure reliability before chaining the rest.
slots.quote: Complexity is emergent; simplicity is designed.
